authority: Scientist answers relayed by the user, plus explicit user answer on empty section-bins
exact_user_confirmation: Average all three, treating empty section-bins as zero; label coverage as uncertain
comparison: Running mean minus Homecage mean, separately for HK1 and PFKP
alignment: Reuse the previous fixed transforms, without fitting
anatomy: User relays scientist confirmation of comparable anatomical regions and sufficient previous alignment for the current exploratory comparison
display_domain: Per-arm union of observed PLA/ChAT bins across all six sections; blank outside that union
